metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent tried to change orientation from Landscape to Portrait via the Properties panel dropdown (reliable prefix, steps 0-2), then doubted itself and opened Slide > Slide Properties dialog (steps 3-6, deviation). Agent visually confirmed Portrait was set but never saved the file, so the evaluator found no change.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can interact with Properties panel dropdown, navigate Slide menu, and open/use Slide Properties dialog. Demonstrated orientation dropdown selection in reliable prefix (steps 0-2).
metadata.failure_analysis: Agent changed the orientation but failed to save the file. The evaluator checks the saved PPTX file on disk, which still had the original landscape orientation.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplest direct version of the original task: change orientation + explicitly save. Targets the reliable prefix actions (Properties panel Orientation dropdown). Evaluator checks PPTX height > width.
metadata.explanation: Getter reads width/height EMU from the saved PPTX. Initial landscape state (width_emu=9950450 > height_emu=7434263) returns is_portrait=False → score 0.0. After agent changes to portrait and saves, height > width → score 1.0. Negative control resistance: landscape PPTX fails immediately.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads PPTX slide_width and slide_height from the saved file using python-pptx, and returns is_portrait = (height > width), which is the standard definition of portrait orientation.
Metric correctly returns 1.0 when is_portrait is True and 0.0 otherwise, with proper error handling.
Covers both task requirements: orientation change (checked via height > width) and file save (getter reads the actual file on disk after postconfig ctrl+s).
Strong negative control resistance: the initial landscape file (width > height) fails immediately with score 0.0.
Error handling in getter is robust: returns error dict on file-not-found or exception, and metric handles it gracefully.
